@OrlaithBallach ...mine are #MeToo, #Racism, #Gender, #Homophobia, #Transgender. I won't add #TraitorTrump to the list bc that's a given for #resisters.

Speaking of, use #Hashtags if you can. You'll reach a broader audience. Alas, that will pull in trump trolls/bots. Just block w/o replying. https://t.co/C7qIR6DjTc

@lough_sydney Whatever non-users may think about Twitter, I have seen it [for better or ill] have a profound influence on how people think about the serious topics of the day [e.g., #MeToo]. And it happens w/alacrity not seen elsewhere.

Pretty sure we had a powerful influence on #impeachment.

@ResisterForever #MeToo began well before it was talked about on Twitter, but few of us knew about it. Thru Twitter, #MeToo survivors connected w/each other to construct a powerful force of women [& their male allies] that has counteracted the stereotypes about rape & sexual harassment▶️

@ResisterForever 2] Twitter makes possible a lot of rapid action &organizing BEYOND the internet. How many marches/protests/sit ins /strong speakers at townhall meetings--so powerful that @GOP officials are terrified to have them?

Speed & easy access to info turned #blacklivesmatter into a mvt▶️
